Stockfish 18 (lite, single-threaded WASM) — vendored from the npm package
`stockfish@18.0.7` (nmrugg/stockfish.js), files bin/stockfish-18-lite-single.{js,wasm}
renamed to stockfish.{js,wasm}. NNUE net is embedded; no separate net file and no
COOP/COEP headers required. Licensed GPLv3 (source: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js).
